title: Clerk feature bento
description: A section heading (centred or left-aligned) over a three-column masonry of 16px feature cards with tiny 13px titles and quiet mock illustrations that animate on hover. Dark tone: a near-black band with notched shoulders, a faint circuit-board backdrop and #212126 cards. Light tone: the grey page with white, softly shadowed cards.
notes: cards take rows/cols spans (1 or 2) and fill the grid densely, in reading order
tone="dark" wraps it in clerk-band; set edgeTop/edgeBottom to the neighbouring sections' colours
